The compound suppresses two pathways: causal attribution to MYC inherits the ambiguity.

context.disease_id: WWOX-deficient human cerebral organoid model (engineered knockout; NOT a patient allele)

This row is the split that the first row hides.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Restoration of cortical neurogenesis in a WWOX-deficient neural model; progenitor identity is restored, layer-neuron production is not.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: Cell-identity markers only; no WWOX-function biomarker, no electrophysiology, no seizure endpoint, no myelin readout.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Engineered knockout organoid, one dose level and one genotype, no treated-wild-type arm; the window between removing excess progenitors and preventing normal corticogenesis is measured nowhere.

cellular_context.target_expression: Wnt/beta-catenin target transcripts are on the up side in the knockout organoid tables; transcript only, raw p, 2 WT versus 4 KO organoids; the activation step (reporter, nuclear beta-catenin) is unmeasured.
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Human cortical organoid progenitors and early neurons, culture stage.
cellular_context.coverage: Brain exposure of the compound class: not measured anywhere in the selected papers.
cellular_context.limits: Canonical Wnt is required for neural progenitor proliferation and cortical patterning (BLOCK-1): the mechanism that removes excess progenitors is the same one that could prevent normal corticogenesis. Lowering MYC/Wnt is not a safe default (CLAIM 028 partner-dependence; restoring WWOX raises apoptotic sensitivity under stress, DL-THER-115).

p4_card.identity: A51: per the organoid source "a multi-kinase inhibitor (A51) established to suppress Wnt and MYC expression". The R3 note treats it as the compound class of a phase-1 adult agent targeting CK1-alpha, CDK7 and CDK9; whether the organoid compound and the clinical agent are the same formulation is carried from that note and not verified here. NOT a MYC inhibitor.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE as target; origin: a knockout human organoid, the only pharmacological intervention ever applied to a human WWOX-deficient neural model. No patient allele; no Q230P-class context.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Already studied in one organoid experiment (one laboratory). NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA in any animal or patient WWOX system.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: partial (progenitors yes, layer neurons no), with an exposure-or-toxicity limit that is unmeasured rather than favourable.
p4_card.expected_contribution: Compensation of a downstream signal; not recovery of WWOX function.
p4_card.mechanism: Targets: multiple kinases (CK1-alpha, CDK7, CDK9 per the R3 note); type: inhibition; direction: Wnt and MYC output down; context: organoid progenitors. The R3 reading of the leukaemia paper does not disentangle Wnt, MYC and CDK for A51.

external_not_wwox_evidence: adult phase-1 study (liver, gastrointestinal, haematological, electrolyte toxicity)
mouse leukaemia study (attribution ambiguous, Myc readout confounded with blast burden)
CSNK1A1 variant families (proposed epileptogenic link, HEK293T only)
Cdk7 neuronal knockout (morphology and social behaviour cost, no seizure endpoint)

for: Progenitor identity and pan-neuronal marking normalised in the knockout organoid.
against: Layer-neuron production did not move (SATB2, CTIP2).
Causal attribution ambiguous: two pathways suppressed; the MYC lane is not shown suppressed in the one mutant line a clinical paper centres on.

Adults: a grade 3 hepatic failure at the highest tested level; pharmacokinetics sub-proportional at the top, so the label 'dose-dependent' for transaminase toxicity is not graded by the paper's own tabulation (R3 § 5); no CNS exposure or paediatric record.
A neurodevelopmental cost of losing Cdk7 in neurons is measured; CSNK1A1 loss is proposed epileptogenic via excess beta-catenin.

No measured window in which Wnt suppression in a developing brain is safe or unsafe in any selected paper; Wnt activation reduced two of four remodelling markers in an adult epilepsy model (opposite direction, different disease).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Engineered null organoid versus patient allele; adult tumour pharmacology versus developing brain.

p4_card.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. Not documented; no registered WOREE study and no paediatric exposure.
p4_card.pharmacology: Potency in organoids measured at one level (not reproduced); selectivity: not selective (multi-kinase); brain exposure: UNKNOWN; adult pharmacokinetics exist in the R3 note.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: No paediatric record exists in the selected records; the only human exposure data are adult. No suitability is presumed. Interactions: UNKNOWN.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: No replication; the review that restates the organoid work writes 'restored' where its own primary shows partial recovery and the significance bracket that would falsify the word is not drawn.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: R3 readings carry recorded receipts and manifests PASS; blind locator audit of all R3 manifests OWED. The A51 panel values cannot be re-audited against the source.

question_history: DL-MOL-003 (direction gate kept a harmful GSK3 candidate out)
p4_card.next_measurement: A dose-by-timing series in a developing-cortex model with a treated wild-type arm, progenitor and layer-neuron endpoints and an electrographic endpoint; a selective MYC inhibitor to separate Wnt from MYC; and a brain-region exposure level in a young animal.
p4_card.status_reason: BLOCK-1 open; causal attribution ambiguous; no paediatric record; direction of benefit not signed.
p4_card.value_added: Makes visible that the one directional match (progenitors) hides a non-match (layer neurons), and that the safety window is measured nowhere.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

not_known: Brain exposure of the compound class.
The therapeutic window between removing excess progenitors and preventing normal corticogenesis.
Which of Wnt, MYC and CDK suppression carries the progenitor effect.
Whether any of this holds in a patient-derived or missense context.
reading_guard: directional_summary is UNRESOLVED because the second assertion (layer neurons) cannot be compared; the first assertion's OPPOSES_DISEASE_CHANGE is a progenitor-identity match inside a knockout organoid and must not be read alone.
card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card; the sources are the repository's own receipted notes and records.
